# WebStarts

> WebStarts is a premier software engineering, mobile app development, and custom web architecture agency based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India.

## Core Capabilities
- **Custom Web Applications:** React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Python/Django, scalable SaaS architecture.
- **Mobile App Development:** React Native, Flutter, native iOS (Swift) & Android (Kotlin) development.
- **UI/UX Design & Prototyping:** User research, wireframing, high-fidelity Figma designs, enterprise design systems.
- **AI Solutions & Workflow Automation:** Custom LLM integrations, AI chatbots, automated business pipelines.
- **Cloud & DevOps:** AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, serverless infrastructure.
